data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Daqr means 'echo' or 'reminder'. This name is derived from the Quranic verse 'And indeed, you are an example to them through your life.', encouraging one to be a reminder of Allah's guidance and blessings. The name Daqr carries the meaning “Echo, Reminder” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Daqr usually hope their child will grow to embody echo, reminder and live with faith, good character and purpose.
